title: Care Coordination Associate
description_text: Harborview Health Partners is looking for a Care Coordination Associate to join our patient services team. You'll handle appointment scheduling, insurance verification, and patient follow-up calls. Last year we rolled out an AI-powered intake assistant that our whole team uses daily to summarize call notes and draft routine patient messages — full training provided, no prior experience with it needed. We're looking for someone organized, comfortable learning new software, and good on the phone. 0-1 years of relevant experience is fine; associate's or bachelor's degree preferred but not required.

title: Claims Support Analyst
description_text: Entry-level Claims Support Analyst role on our property claims team. You'll review incoming claims files and use our AI-assisted document review tool to flag inconsistencies and draft summary notes for the adjusters who make final decisions. We provide on-the-job training on the AI tool itself. No prior insurance experience required — we're looking for someone detail-oriented who can pick up new systems quickly. Recent grads and career changers welcome to apply.

title: Product Support Specialist
description_text: Fernhollow AI makes workflow automation software for small logistics companies. We're hiring a Product Support Specialist to sit between our customers and our product team. Day to day: you'll configure our AI assistant for new customers during onboarding, triage support tickets, and translate what customers are asking for into notes the product team can act on. You don't need a technical background — we're specifically looking for someone who's done customer-facing product, solutions, or implementation work before and is comfortable being the go-between. We'll train you on the AI-specific parts of the tool.

title: Merchandise Planning Coordinator
description_text: Larkspur & Co. is hiring a Merchandise Planning Coordinator to support our buying team. You'll work in our AI-powered demand forecasting tool to help build assortment and inventory plans, alongside standard spreadsheet work. Retail, customer service, or operations background is helpful but not required — we're more interested in someone comfortable with numbers and new software. Fully remote, entry-level, no coding involved.

title: Administrative Assistant
description_text: Front desk Administrative Assistant needed for a busy dental office. Responsibilities include greeting patients, scheduling appointments in our practice management software, filing, and answering phones. Entry-level, no degree required. We're a small, friendly office and looking for someone reliable and personable.

title: Director of AI Operations
description_text: Quill Systems is seeking a Director of AI Operations to own the strategy and rollout of AI tooling across our internal operations teams. You'll set the roadmap for AI adoption, manage a team of operations leads, and report directly to the COO. Requires 8+ years leading operations teams, with at least 3 years specifically managing AI or automation program rollouts at a mid-size or large company. Strong stakeholder management and executive presentation skills required.

title: Product Solutions Analyst
description_text: Nexora AI, a fast-growing generative AI startup, is hiring a Product Solutions Analyst. You'll gather requirements from internal stakeholders, write detailed functional specs, coordinate handoffs with the engineering team, and track project timelines in Jira. Requires 4-6 years of experience as a business analyst or solutions analyst, strong SQL skills, and experience running stakeholder workshops. This is a highly cross-functional role at the center of our product organization.

title: AI Prompt Writer Needed for Chatbot Testing
description_text: Looking for someone to test and refine prompts for a customer support chatbot. Pay is per completed task, roughly 20-30 tasks available per week to start. This is freelance contract work, no benefits, no set schedule. Great side project for someone interested in AI.

title: AI Tools Coordinator
description_text: Prairie Regional Medical Center is hiring an AI Tools Coordinator to support clinical staff using our new AI scribe software, which transcribes and summarizes patient visit notes in real time. You'll manage training sessions for new staff, troubleshoot day-to-day issues, and be the point person between clinical staff and our software vendor. No clinical or coding background required — we're looking for someone patient, organized, and comfortable training others on new technology. Entry-level, on-site role, no remote option.

title: AI Builder Intern
description_text: Vantek Robotics is looking for an AI Builder Intern to join our applied ML team for a summer internship. You'll help build and fine-tune models for our robotics perception stack. Requires: currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, proficiency in Python, and hands-on experience with PyTorch or a similar deep learning framework. Prior research or coursework in computer vision is a plus.

title: Student Services Coordinator
description_text: Support adult learners by answering enrollment questions, scheduling advising sessions, and maintaining student records. You will use an AI-powered advising assistant to summarize student conversations, recommend approved resources, and draft follow-up messages for staff review. No degree or prior technology experience is required; customer service, education, or community-program experience is welcome, and training is provided.

title: Permit Intake Assistant
description_text: Review incoming permit applications for completeness and help residents correct missing information. You will operate an AI document-intake tool that extracts application fields, flags possible omissions, and produces plain-language summaries for review by permitting staff. This role requires a high school diploma or equivalent and does not require previous government or technical experience.

title: Legal Intake Coordinator
description_text: Conduct initial client intake, organize submitted records, and route matters to the appropriate legal team. The coordinator uses an AI document-review assistant to identify document types, create timelines, and draft intake summaries, but attorneys make all legal determinations. One year of administrative, call-center, social-services, or customer-facing experience is preferred; legal experience is not required.

title: Development Operations Assistant
description_text: Maintain donor records, prepare acknowledgment messages, and support fundraising campaigns for youth programs. The assistant uses a generative-AI writing tool with approved templates to draft donor communications and an AI record-matching feature to identify possible duplicate contacts. Training is provided, and applicants need only basic spreadsheet skills and up to one year of administrative experience.

title: Customer Onboarding Coordinator
description_text: Guide small-business customers through setup, schedule training sessions, and track onboarding milestones. In daily work, you will use an AI call-summary assistant to capture action items and an AI knowledge-search tool to find approved answers during customer meetings. No coding is required; one to two years in customer support, hospitality, sales coordination, or account services is preferred.

title: Guest Experience Coordinator
description_text: Support our front desk team in delivering personalized stays for guests at our boutique Manhattan properties. You'll use our AI concierge recommendation tool to draft tailored itinerary suggestions based on guest preferences, then refine and send them before arrival. 1-2 years of hospitality or customer service experience preferred but not required. This is an on-site role with weekend rotation.

title: Dispatch Operations Associate
description_text: Join our regional dispatch team coordinating last-mile deliveries across the tri-state area. You'll work with our AI route-optimization platform to review suggested delivery sequences, adjust for real-time traffic and customer windows, and communicate changes to drivers. We're looking for someone detail-oriented with strong communication skills; we provide full training on the routing software. 1 year of dispatch or coordination experience a plus.

title: Listings Coordinator
description_text: Support our residential brokerage team by preparing property listings, coordinating showings, and maintaining our listings database. You'll use our AI valuation tool to generate comparable-property analyses and suggested listing prices, then review and adjust them with the listing agent before publication. 1 year of real estate or administrative experience preferred. Must be organized and comfortable with property management software.

title: Quality Assurance Coordinator
description_text: Coordinate quality inspections on our precision components production line. You'll use our AI visual-inspection tool to review flagged parts, log defect patterns, and prepare daily quality reports for the production manager. No engineering background needed; we provide full training on the inspection software. High school diploma and 1-2 years of manufacturing or warehouse experience required.

title: Onboarding Specialist
description_text: Join Cindervale AI's customer success team to onboard new users to our contract-analysis platform. You'll run structured demos, configure each client's workspace, and use our in-house AI assistant to draft customized onboarding guides based on each client's contract types. 1-2 years of customer-facing experience (support, account coordination, or similar) required. No technical background needed, but comfort learning new software is essential.

title: Patient Services Coordinator
description_text: Coordinate front-desk operations at our community health clinic, including scheduling appointments, verifying insurance information, and answering patient questions. You'll use an AI intake assistant that drafts appointment summaries and flags scheduling conflicts for staff review; all clinical questions are directed to medical staff. No healthcare experience required — we provide full training. Strong communication skills and comfort learning new software are essential.

title: Customer Support Associate
description_text: Respond to customer inquiries about orders, returns, and product questions for our online home goods store. You'll use an AI support-triage tool that categorizes incoming tickets and drafts suggested responses, which you review and personalize before sending. No retail or e-commerce experience required; training provided. Up to one year of any customer-facing experience is a plus.

title: Paratransit Scheduling Assistant
description_text: Coordinate daily pickup and drop-off schedules for riders using our accessible transportation service. You'll use an AI scheduling-optimization tool that suggests efficient routes and appointment windows, then confirm and adjust them based on rider needs. No transportation industry background required; we train on all systems. Strong phone communication skills needed.

title: Catering Operations Coordinator
description_text: Support our catering team by confirming event orders, coordinating delivery logistics, and communicating with clients about menu changes. You'll use an AI forecasting tool that estimates ingredient needs based on past events, reviewing its suggestions with the kitchen manager before finalizing orders. No prior catering experience required; food service or event coordination background is a plus.

title: Claims Intake Associate
description_text: Process incoming insurance claims by collecting documentation and verifying basic policy information before routing files to adjusters. You'll use an AI claims-categorization tool that flags claim type and urgency, which you confirm before assignment; all coverage decisions are made by licensed adjusters. No insurance license or prior claims experience required — we provide paid training.

title: Loan Processing Assistant
description_text: Support our lending team by collecting member documentation and preparing loan files for review. You'll use an AI document-verification tool that checks submitted paperwork for completeness and flags missing items, then follow up with members directly. No lending or financial background required; comfort with basic office software and strong attention to detail are what matter most.

title: Visitor Programs Coordinator
description_text: Coordinate school-group visits and public programs at our cultural center, including scheduling, ticketing, and visitor communications. You'll use an AI feedback-summary tool that groups visitor survey responses by theme for the programs team, and help draft follow-up materials for group leaders. No museum or nonprofit experience required; we're looking for someone organized and personable.

title: Client Care Coordinator
description_text: Greet clients, schedule appointments, and follow up with pet owners after visits at our veterinary practice. You'll use an AI assistant that drafts personalized appointment reminders and post-visit care summaries based on the vet's notes, which you review before sending. No veterinary experience required; comfort around animals and strong communication skills are essential.

title: Inventory Control Associate
description_text: Track stock levels, process incoming shipments, and reconcile inventory counts at our distribution center. You'll use an AI demand-forecasting dashboard that flags items likely to run low, reviewing its recommendations before submitting reorder requests. No warehouse experience required; we provide full training on our inventory systems. High school diploma required.

title: Box Office & Patron Services Associate
description_text: Sell tickets, answer patron questions, and coordinate group sales for our theater's performance season. You'll use an AI tool that drafts personalized follow-up emails to patrons based on their ticket history, which you review and send. No prior box office or theater experience required; evening and weekend availability needed for performances.

title: Shipping and Receiving Clerk
description_text: Ironbridge Freight is hiring a Shipping and Receiving Clerk for our Newark warehouse. Responsibilities include scanning incoming packages, updating inventory spreadsheets, staging outbound shipments, and general warehouse organization. High school diploma required, no prior experience necessary. Forklift certification a plus but not required.

title: Attendance Records Clerk
description_text: Track and record daily student attendance across three school buildings, enter data into the district's student information system, and contact parents regarding unexcused absences. No degree required beyond a high school diploma; prior office or clerical experience preferred but not required. Standard district software training provided.

title: Head of Marketing Analytics
description_text: Ridgeline Consumer Brands is hiring a Head of Marketing Analytics to lead our data function. You'll set strategy for our AI-powered customer segmentation and campaign-optimization platform, present insights directly to the executive team, and manage a team of four analysts. Requires 7+ years of marketing analytics experience, at least 3 years managing a team, and an advanced background in statistics or a related quantitative field.

title: Senior Underwriter, Commercial Lines
description_text: Fairmont Casualty is hiring a Senior Underwriter for our commercial lines team. You'll make final underwriting decisions on complex commercial accounts, using our AI risk-scoring platform to inform your judgment calls on pricing and terms. Requires 7+ years of commercial underwriting experience and an active underwriting license. Mentors junior underwriters on the team.

title: Business Operations Analyst
description_text: Aurelian Intelligence, a generative-AI startup, is hiring a Business Operations Analyst. You'll build and maintain spreadsheet models for headcount planning, prepare materials for board meetings, and coordinate cross-functional projects between engineering, sales, and finance. Requires 3-5 years of operations, business analysis, or FP&A experience, and advanced Excel skills. Fast-paced, high-growth environment.

title: Client Solutions Coordinator
description_text: Vireo Cognitive Systems, an AI infrastructure company, is hiring a Client Solutions Coordinator. You'll schedule and coordinate client meetings, maintain records in Salesforce, and prepare standard slide decks in Google Slides for quarterly client check-ins. No prior experience required, full training provided. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail a must.

title: AI Chatbot Trainer - Freelance Gigs Available
description_text: Sign up to complete freelance chatbot training gigs on your own schedule. Browse available projects, submit your work, and get paid per completed gig. No interview process, no employer of record, work as much or as little as you want. Just need a computer and internet connection.

title: Entry-Level AI Operations Role - Confidential Client
description_text: Pinnacle Talent Partners is recruiting on behalf of a confidential client for an entry-level opportunity assisting with various AI-related operational tasks. Contract-to-hire position. Pay rate to be discussed upon application. Apply now to learn more details about the client and role.

title: AI Support Engineer I
description_text: Entry-level AI Support Engineer I role troubleshooting customer issues on our AI API platform. You'll read and debug Python scripts submitted by customers, write SQL queries against production logs to investigate issues, and troubleshoot REST API integration problems. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field preferred.

title: Client Success Associate
description_text: Thornwell Analytics, a small AI-powered analytics company serving mid-market clients, is hiring a Client Success Associate. You'll configure each client's AI dashboard during onboarding, answer day-to-day product questions, and work closely with the product team to relay feature requests. No technical background required — we're looking for someone with prior experience in a client-facing role such as account coordination, customer support, or a solutions/analyst position, even without AI-specific experience. Full training provided on our AI tooling.

title: Learning Support Coordinator
description_text: Coordinate daily operations of our after-school tutoring program, including scheduling, family communications, and progress tracking. You'll use our AI-powered tutoring assistant platform to generate personalized practice sets for each student and review AI-generated progress summaries before sharing them with families. No prior tutoring experience required; we'll train you on the platform. Strong organization and communication skills are what we're looking for.

title: Legal Intake Specialist
description_text: Be the first point of contact for clients seeking legal aid, conducting intake interviews and preparing case files for our attorneys. You'll use our AI document-review tool to scan incoming paperwork, flag relevant clauses, and generate summary memos that attorneys use to triage cases. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; no legal background needed. Bilingual Spanish a plus.

title: Community Services Coordinator
description_text: Help families navigate housing, food assistance, and benefits programs at our Bronx resource center. You'll use our AI intake assistant to guide structured conversations with clients, verify eligibility, and auto-populate application forms for state benefits. Patience, empathy, and comfort learning new software are essential. Prior case management experience is helpful but not required.

title: Content Operations Associate
description_text: Help manage our digital content library across podcast and video properties. You'll use our AI auto-tagging platform to generate metadata for new episodes, review and correct the AI's suggested tags, and ensure consistent categorization across our archive. Strong writing skills and attention to detail required; no prior media experience necessary. This is a great role for someone who loves organizing information.

title: Customer Success Associate
description_text: Support our self-published authors as they navigate our publishing platform, answering questions and triaging issues. You'll use our AI support-assistant to draft responses to common author inquiries, then personalize and send them; more complex issues you'll handle directly. We actively welcome career changers from retail support, hospitality, or coordination backgrounds — no publishing experience required. This is a fully remote role; candidates must be based in the US.

title: Administrative Assistant
description_text: Provide administrative support to our library director and program coordinators. Responsibilities include managing calendars, processing interlibrary loan requests, greeting patrons, and maintaining program attendance records. Strong organizational skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office required. High school diploma required; associate's degree preferred.

title: Director of Revenue Operations
description_text: Lead our revenue management team across 14 properties, setting pricing strategy and forecasting demand. You'll use our AI pricing-optimization platform to model rate scenarios, review the AI's recommendations, and approve daily rate changes across the portfolio. Requires 7+ years of revenue management experience in hospitality and proven team leadership. MBA preferred.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description_text: Support our marketing team in executing campaigns across email, social, and paid channels. Responsibilities include drafting newsletter copy, scheduling social posts, tracking campaign metrics, and coordinating with our design team on creative assets. 2-3 years of B2B marketing experience required. Familiarity with HubSpot and Google Analytics preferred.

title: Virtual Assistant for AI Startup
description_text: Client is seeking a freelance virtual assistant to support a growing AI startup with calendar management, inbox triage, and light data entry. Must be available during US business hours. This is a 1099 contract position with no benefits. Please submit your hourly rate and availability with your proposal.

title: Entry-Level Machine Learning Engineer
description_text: We're hiring an entry-level ML engineer to join our model development team. You'll train and fine-tune models using PyTorch and TensorFlow, write production Python code, and participate in code reviews. Requirements: BS in Computer Science or related field, demonstrated experience with deep learning frameworks, and fluency in SQL. Recent grads welcome to apply.

title: Permit Clerk
description_text: Process building permit applications at our municipal permits office. Duties include reviewing applications for completeness, collecting fees, scheduling inspections, and answering applicant questions by phone and in person. High school diploma required; one year of clerical experience preferred. Civil service exam required.

title: Head of Underwriting
description_text: Lead our commercial underwriting function and oversee a team of 12 underwriters. You'll use our AI risk-scoring tool to review flagged applications, validate the model's recommendations, and sign off on policies above team authority limits. Requires 10+ years of commercial underwriting experience and 3+ years of people management. CPCU designation strongly preferred.

title: AI Product Marketing Manager
description_text: Drive go-to-market strategy for our enterprise AI products. You'll develop positioning, create sales enablement materials, and run product launches in coordination with engineering and sales. Requirements: 4+ years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience, with at least 1 year in AI or ML-adjacent products. Strong writing and presentation skills required.

title: AI Research Intern
description_text: Join our research team for a 12-week summer internship investigating retrieval-augmented generation. Interns will implement experiments in Python, fine-tune transformer models using Hugging Face, and contribute to internal research papers. Requirements: currently enrolled in a CS, statistics, or ML PhD program; prior publication at NeurIPS, ICML, or ACL a plus. Stipend provided.

title: Data Labeling Specialist (Freelance)
description_text: Buyer is looking for freelancers to label training data for image recognition models on a per-task basis. You'll classify objects in images according to a provided taxonomy. Payment is per accepted task; no guaranteed hours. This is a freelance gig posted on the Fiverr marketplace.
